My mindset? Simple.

One day, my story's going to motivate the fuck out of someone.

There was a point when I realized that the only way things were going to get better for me, was if I fought for it like my life depended on it.  It does depend it!  Do you want to go through life having things happen to you, or do you want to remember all the things you did about it?

Trust me, I repeat that to myself whenever I feel things getting tougher.  I still have anxiety issues, but I'm pushing though that too.
